title: ジャパンダートダービーの後に・立心

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (The race is over… and I saw the brilliance beyond the clouds of dirt and dust.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Though the conditions and environment were different, that brilliance was exactly the same.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (So that's it. The magnificence of Umamusume that has possessed me since I was young…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (I have discovered its source…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please listen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I figured something out after running in the Japan Dirt Derby today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is over, yet Agnes Digital has the same serious expression as when she was running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume are… cute.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume are… precious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But why are they so cute and so precious? Why do they tug at my heart so?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I saw the answer today, clear as day! The reason is…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They're always chasing after their dreams with their whole hearts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital begins stamping her feet on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If I could only slap my former self for even entertaining the idea that only the mainstream turf G1 races were special!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume are always the same! Every single one of them is sincere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whether it's something they want or something they're trying to become, they pursue it with all their might.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They compete, uplift, and push each other—and no one ever backs away from a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And they know that sometimes they will have to fight to be first. Yet they keep looking ahead, unafraid of that clash.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, when they've achieved their goals, they frolick and ease their hearts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's precisely what shakes my soul and makes me wanna fall down in praise!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I thought I understood this before I debuted, but now that I've been running…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's all become crystal clear! Everything's on a completely different level than I'd thought—the size of their dreams, the pain of chasing them, and the strength of their bonds born along the way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I flew into the Twinkle Series with the simple desire to see it up close, with no idea how deep it ran…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I am much too small the way I am now… I can't continue like this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Doto and Opera O are my top two oshis, and they showed me something brilliant at the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm not fit to stand beside them as I am now. I'm not even qualified to simp for them. Unless!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume myself, if I can fix my resolve and stand at the starting gate with a pure heart, then…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you think that I… Can I do it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If I master the path before me, as a maverick—an all-rounder—can I become worthy of standing beside Opera O and Doto?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Can I actually do it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt in my mind. Whatever she may say, Agnes Digital has already overcome every trial on her road to achieve what she's set her mind on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So long as her goal is clear, she has what it takes to traverse any road, no matter how difficult.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In that case… In that case…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I will become a proper Umamusume! I'm gonna be worthy of running alongside the others with a certified license to simp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And so! That's why!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her resolute voice rings out into the summer sky. For Agnes Digital, the real Twinkle Series begins now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With that said, let's talk about our next race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanna run with more experienced runners—wonderful Umamusume who can help get me on the right track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More experienced runners would mean those in their senior year. With Agnes Digital still in her classic year, she's asking for a rigorous challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that case, it would be best to choose a distance she's run already. Seeing as she's run a mile before at the NHK Mile Cup…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship! That's the race King dominated last year!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanna run there too! Maybe there's some leftover speck of King's spirit lingering there that I can inherit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our next race goal is the Mile Championship in the fall.
